commits.message:
fix(durable): type ToolControl.terminate as boolean

The type change and changelog entry landed in 1de1b98e7; this adds the
regression test for terminate: false.

closes #10858

feat(durable): per-model compaction settings via compaction.modelOverrides

Overrides keyed by provider/modelId apply at the threshold check, overflow
recovery, and compaction range selection.

closes #10942

fix(durable): restore ToolControl.terminate changes dropped by c4cf7957b

c4cf7957b was built from a tree that predates 6085986e4 and reverted its
terminate type change, regression test, and changelog entries.

sources.mechanism: Exact provider/modelId overrides replace enabled/reserveTokens/keepRecentTokens/backgroundTokens field by field. Generation threshold resolves current model; overflow recovery resolves the checkpointed request model; compaction selection/cut/summary sizing resolves its selected model. Terminate boolean type/noop regression and read-only StorageRequestError documentation are companion changes, not new termination/storage runtime implementation.
sources.acceptance_delta: Pin and record policy/model snapshots for threshold, request-overflow and compaction selection/retries across model changes and restarts. Test matching/nonmatching override, enabledfalse and zero values, summary sizing, changed policy across phases, with real final effects before full-harness status upgrade.
sources.proof_boundary: All17 patches across3true-parent commits read; first6085986e introduces all9final changed files despite terminate title; c4cf7957 erroneously drops type/test/storage doc;790271cd restores them. Aggregate parent4954d760..head790271cd has9file blob SHAs exactly equal to6085986e tree. Three faux-provider regression cases; no local or upstream test execution.
sources.ci_boundary: True CI38873093464 at restoredhead790271cd completed/failure. Other successful label/catalog/Nix workflows do not replace it. No jobs/logs or failure cause audited.
sources.discussion_boundary: Both issue bodies and full3comments each read; original requests byfinnvoor10942 andjpenilla10858. badlogic collaborator closure comments explicitly AI-generated by/wr and corroborate collision/restore; source patches are primary evidence.
sources.known_residual: No independent provider/model-switch/restart proof or measured quality/token/cost improvement.

Policy publication withinadmitUserTurn awaits remains a negative control; followup/handoff blobs unchanged. No local reproduction or authoritative resolved-state query.
